adaptation.reason: The source omitted the parallelogram and perpendicular-bisector conditions from its English text. They are stated explicitly to make the intended construction determinate; the perimeter remains a visual given.

audit.independent_solution: Diagonals of a parallelogram bisect one another, so O is the midpoint of AC. Since EO⊥AC, E is equidistant from A and C, giving EA=EC. Thus DC+DE+EC=DC+DA=16, half the parallelogram perimeter (B for 72, D for 79).
